About Harbourside Literacy Trust

The trust started in 2014 when two primary teachers noticed that the children who fell furthest behind in reading were the ones nobody read with at home. They recruited twelve volunteers for one school. Today 140 volunteers read with more than six hundred children every week.

How the trust is run

Executive Director: Amara Okafor. Chair of trustees: Daniel Reyes. Six further trustees meet quarterly; minutes are published on request. Charity registration number 1187654.

Funding

Around half of the trust's income comes from individual donors, a third from grant-making foundations, and the rest from schools that contribute towards the cost of their club. The annual report is available on request.
